question: Add the term bittorrent to the interface vocabulary (interface[] in the record schema)?
why: The Stack Exchange network dump is distributed as BitTorrent torrents (Academic Torrents lists an infohash and a mirror count for it) and is read with a BitTorrent client; the record lists rest and names BitTorrent in its text. Records whose access path is BitTorrent list rest (storage/academic-torrents, storage/internet-archive-bittorrents) or unknown (storage/bittorrent-webtorrent-seeding). Four records need it; recommend adding bittorrent.
